create-table-references: The new table is empty, so its chat thread, chat turn, run and runner foreign keys validate no existing rows. The referenced tables take bounded locks under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
row-level-security: Enabling and forcing RLS changes only metadata on the new empty table, bounded by 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-policy: The owner-only and deny-application policies are metadata on the new empty table, bounded by 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
add-constraint: The widened reject-reason check replaces the old one on desktop_runner_runs, which holds few rows (pruned ended runs), so validation reads them within the 5s statement_timeout and ACCESS EXCLUSIVE acquisition is bounded by the 1s lock_timeout.
